name: Re-Fuse Gen 2

origin.basis: Maxxis says it began in 1967 as a bicycle-tire maker in Taiwan.

manufacturing.basis: Maxxis' size table does not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Durable training and commuting road tire with a full-silica all-season compound and MaxxShield protection.

wet_notes.summary: Maxxis describes a full-silica, all-season compound with micro knobs for cornering control.

availability.note: Listed on Maxxis' US site with a dealer locator; mainland China and European availability not verified for this generation.

caveats: A 40 mm tubeless-ready Re-Fuse uses a different construction and is not part of this record.
Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2019 Re-Fuse test predates Gen 2 and is not applied.

image.shown: Maxxis render of the Re-Fuse Gen 2 on its US product page.
image.alt: Maxxis Re-Fuse Gen 2 road tire render with sidewall logo
